title: Claude Fable 5
content:
## Overview

Claude Fable 5, released June 9, 2026, is the first publicly available "Mythos-class" model from Anthropic. It represents a step-change in capability over the Claude 4 family — Anthropic describes it as the most capable model it has ever made generally available. The model is designed for extended autonomous work in coding, scientific research, financial analysis, legal review, and other knowledge-intensive domains.

The model ID is `claude-fable-5`.

---

## Background: The Mythos Program

Anthropic's internal "Mythos" research program produced a class of models significantly more capable than the Claude 4 Opus line. Prior to Fable 5, Mythos models were available only in a restricted preview program. During that preview, the models demonstrated exceptional ability to autonomously discover and chain zero-day exploits across major operating systems and browsers — a capability that raised significant safety questions before any public release.

Fable 5 is the version of the Mythos-class model that passed Anthropic's safety evaluations for general availability. Rather than disabling high-risk capabilities outright, Anthropic routes certain query categories to a safer fallback model.

---

## Benchmark Performance

| Benchmark | Fable 5 | Opus 4.8 |
|---|---|---|
| SWE-Bench Pro | **80.3%** | 69.2% |
| Hex Analytical | **>90%** | — |

Fable 5 achieves state-of-the-art results on nearly all tested benchmarks in software engineering, knowledge work, vision, and scientific research. It is the first model to exceed 90% on Hex's analytical benchmark.

---

## Key Capabilities

### Extended Autonomous Coding

Fable 5 can execute complex, multi-step coding tasks — including multi-file refactors, test-driven development, dependency upgrades, and architecture changes — for extended periods without intervention. Its SWE-Bench Pro score of 80.3% (vs. 69.2% for Opus 4.8) reflects a meaningful jump in real-world software engineering task completion.

### Vision and Document Understanding

The model has substantially improved vision, understanding diagrams, charts, and tables embedded in PDFs and documents. This is particularly valuable in finance (SEC filings, financial models), legal (contract review), and architecture (design documents) workflows where visual-heavy documents are central to the work.

### Scientific Research Tasks

Fable 5 shows notable gains on scientific reasoning — hypothesis generation, literature synthesis, and experimental design — making it Anthropic's first model positioned for autonomous research assistant use cases.

---

## Safety Architecture

Fable 5 ships with a query-routing safety layer rather than simple refusals:

- Queries on topics with elevated misuse risk (cybersecurity, biology, chemistry, health) are rerouted to Claude Opus 4.8
- This fallback triggers in fewer than 5% of sessions on average
- Users receive capable responses from Opus 4.8 rather than outright refusals

This architecture is novel: instead of either refusing the query or answering it with a frontier model, Anthropic routes high-risk queries to a capable but more constrained model. The policy is designed to reduce misuse without degrading the overall user experience.

---

## Pricing

| Token type | Price |
|---|---|
| Input | $10 per million tokens |
| Output | $50 per million tokens |
| Prompt cache (input) | $1 per million tokens (90% discount) |

This is exactly 2× the cost of Claude Opus 4.8 ($5/$25 per million tokens). Through June 22, 2026, Fable 5 is included in Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans at no extra cost. Starting June 23, 2026, Fable 5 requires usage credits on all plans.

---

## Availability

- **API:** `claude-fable-5` model ID
- **AWS:** Available via the Claude Platform on AWS with built-in safeguards
- **Claude.ai:** Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise plans (free access through June 22, 2026; usage credits required from June 23)
